scripts.dev:setup: npm run dev:sync && npm run dev:set-admin-password
scripts.dev:cli: cd backend && wp-env run cli wp
scripts.dev:plugin:install: cd backend && WP_CLI="npx wp-env run cli wp" ./install_plugins.sh
scripts.dev:set-admin-password: cd backend && WP_CLI="npx wp-env run cli wp" ./set-admin-password.sh
scripts.dev:plugin:list: cd backend && wp-env run cli wp plugin list
scripts.dev:db:reset: cd backend && wp-env run cli wp db reset --yes
scripts.dev:migrate:up: cd backend && WP_CLI="npx wp-env run cli wp" bash ./run-site-core-migrations.sh up
scripts.dev:migrate:down: cd backend && WP_CLI="npx wp-env run cli wp" bash ./run-site-core-migrations.sh down
scripts.dev:migrate:latest: cd backend && WP_CLI="npx wp-env run cli wp" bash ./run-site-core-migrations.sh latest
scripts.dev:migrate:full-rollback: cd backend && WP_CLI="npx wp-env run cli wp" bash ./run-site-core-migrations.sh full-rollback
scripts.dev:sync: npm run dev:start && npm run dev:plugin:install && npm run dev:migrate
scripts.prod:sync: npm run prod:plugin:install && npm run prod:migrate
